test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. As a boy Elon was a keen reader and learnt how to code computers.

Q. He even made his own video game called Blastar.

R. Later he moved to Canada and then the United States setting up his first company with his brother Kimbal in 1995.

S. But after some time, he sold that company to create a company called X.com.
solution:
The correct answer is** PQRS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence P** is the first sentence which introduces a boy named Elon.
 
• The second sentence should be **sentence Q** which gives more information about the boy that he also made his own video game.
 
• **Sentence R** should be the third sentence which says that after sometime Elon moved to Canada and the United States where he set up his first company.
 
• **Sentence S** should be the last sentence which says that the company was sold by him later. 
 
• Thus, the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph is **option 4.** 

**Correct Sequence:**__ ***P.** As a boy Elon was a keen reader and learnt how to code computers. **Q. **He even made his own video game called Blastar.** R.** Later he moved to Canada and then the United States setting up his first company with his brother Kimbal in 1995. **S.** But after some time, he sold that company to create a company called X.com.*
